        and ("orders"."cancelled_at" is not null) = ("orders"."status" = 'cancelled')
        and ("orders"."status" not in ('confirmed', 'delivered') or "orders"."confirmed_at" is not null)
        and ("orders"."status" <> 'pending' or "orders"."confirmed_at" is null)

        and ("service_orders"."kind" = 'customer_device') = ("service_orders"."unit_id" is null)
        and ("service_orders"."kind" = 'customer_device' or "service_orders"."device_serial" is null)

service_orders_own_unit_path.name: service_orders_own_unit_path
service_orders_own_unit_path.value:
"service_orders"."kind" = 'customer_device'
        or ("service_orders"."quoted_at" is null and "service_orders"."delivered_at" is null and "service_orders"."sale_id" is null)

service_orders_technician_sent.name: service_orders_technician_sent
service_orders_technician_sent.value: ("service_orders"."technician_id" is not null) = ("service_orders"."sent_at" is not null)

service_orders_quote_together.name: service_orders_quote_together
service_orders_quote_together.value:
("service_orders"."quoted_at" is not null) = ("service_orders"."customer_currency" is not null)
        and ("service_orders"."quoted_at" is not null) = ("service_orders"."customer_total" is not null)
        and ("service_orders"."technician_currency" is not null) = ("service_orders"."technician_total" is not null)
        and ("service_orders"."technician_total" is not null) = case when "service_orders"."kind" = 'customer_device'
          then "service_orders"."quoted_at" is not null else "service_orders"."repaired_at" is not null end

service_orders_dates_chain.name: service_orders_dates_chain
service_orders_dates_chain.value:
("service_orders"."quoted_at" is null or "service_orders"."sent_at" is not null)
        and ("service_orders"."approved_at" is null or "service_orders"."quoted_at" is not null)
        and ("service_orders"."rejected_at" is null or "service_orders"."quoted_at" is not null)
        and ("service_orders"."approved_at" is null or "service_orders"."rejected_at" is null)
        and ("service_orders"."repaired_at" is null or "service_orders"."sent_at" is not null)
        and ("service_orders"."repaired_at" is null or "service_orders"."approved_at" is not null or "service_orders"."kind" <> 'customer_device')

service_orders_status_dates.name: service_orders_status_dates
service_orders_status_dates.value:
("service_orders"."delivered_at" is not null) = ("service_orders"."status" = 'delivered')
        and ("service_orders"."cancelled_at" is not null) = ("service_orders"."status" = 'cancelled')
        and ("service_orders"."cancel_reason" is not null) = ("service_orders"."status" = 'cancelled')
        and case "service_orders"."status"
          when 'received' then "service_orders"."sent_at" is null
          when 'sent' then "service_orders"."sent_at" is not null and "service_orders"."quoted_at" is null
          when 'quoted' then "service_orders"."quoted_at" is not null and "service_orders"."approved_at" is null and "service_orders"."rejected_at" is null
          when 'approved' then "service_orders"."approved_at" is not null and "service_orders"."repaired_at" is null
          when 'rejected' then "service_orders"."rejected_at" is not null
          when 'repaired' then "service_orders"."repaired_at" is not null
          when 'delivered' then ("service_orders"."repaired_at" is not null) <> ("service_orders"."rejected_at" is not null)
          when 'cancelled' then "service_orders"."repaired_at" is null and "service_orders"."rejected_at" is null
        end

service_orders_sale_delivered.name: service_orders_sale_delivered
service_orders_sale_delivered.value: ("service_orders"."sale_id" is not null) = ("service_orders"."status" = 'delivered' and "service_orders"."repaired_at" is not null)
